name: Desktop Architecture Paradigm
shortDesc: Choose between hand-assembling modular daemons or installing an integrated Desktop Environment.
detailedDesc: Hand-assembled setups let you pair your own compositor (Hyprland/Sway), bar (Waybar), launcher (Walker/Rofi), and utilities. A full DE bundles everything into one cohesive pre-configured suite.

phase.title: Base & Architecture
phase.description: Core display server protocols, desktop architecture paradigms, and package manager helpers.

packages.name: Hand-Assembled Modular Stack (Ricing Choice)
packages.description: Individual selection of compositor, bar, launcher, lockscreen, notification center, and custom QoL tools.
pros: Complete freedom of choice across every single component
cons: Requires individual component selection (guided by SimpleArch)

packages.name: Full Desktop Environment (DE)
packages.description: Integrated desktop suite (KDE Plasma, GNOME, etc.) providing a unified shell, settings panel, and apps.
pros: Everything works out of the box
